_doc: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for how each model is configured AND invoked per task. Scripts read this (via run_bench.py) so invocations are canonical - no ad-hoc flags, nothing forgotten. Per-task knobs include think, num_predict, bug_num_predict (code task only: the bug-finding output budget, kept separate from the generation num_predict), and scalar Ollama option overrides such as temperature/top_p; params document the best sampling baked into configs/*.Modelfile. think values are exactly what --think= expects: false | true | low | high. 'thinking': controllable | none | forced (gpt-oss: cannot be disabled, only leveled). reasoning num_predict is high for thinking models (thinking eats budget; runaway-safe). speed always think=false (throughput convention, matches the energy table).

qwen36-best.notes: unsloth params (top_p 0.8). Code needs think=false or it gets lost; reasoning needs thinking ON (+2.0). Modelfile num_predict 3000 is the bare-run default; run_bench overrides per task.

qwen-coder-best.notes: Dedicated coder, no thinking. Efficiency king (~61 tok/s).

gpt-oss-best.notes: Thinking HARDCODED (harmony) - cannot disable, only level. Code profile temp 0.3; run_bench overrides reasoning calls to temp 1.0. NEVER temp 0 (100% loops). speed uses think=low (its floor).

north-best.notes: Thinking model. Code profile top_p 0.8; run_bench overrides reasoning calls to top_p 0.95.

phi4-best.notes: temp 0.7 measured more stable than native higher temp on reasoning (range 4 -> 0). Top logic-puzzle reasoner (5.33), worst code.

devstral-best.notes: Base is the benchmarked devstral-small-2:24b-fast (NOT public devstral:24b). Slow (~14 tok/s cold), strong non-thinking reasoner (5.0).

unsloth-q4xl-best.notes: Qwen3.5 Q4_K_XL, nothink baked in (cannot enable thinking). Balanced code 6 + reasoning 5.0.

gemma-best.notes: Gemma 4 E4B (8B total / ~4.5B effective). Official temp 1.0 (top_k 64, top_p 0.95). THINKING: E4B is the documented exception (official card flags E2B/E4B); via the ollama API think=None already thinks - pass think=false for the real no-thinking mode. Reasoning: true OFF (think=false) 3.0, ON 5.0 (+2.0). Code uses think=false (unaffected). Also the neutral cross-family judge.

deepseek-r1-best.notes: CRITICAL: num_ctx MUST be 8192 - the default 131072 = 54 GB = crash on 64 GB. Very slow (~4 tok/s). Dropped from the main fleet (slowest + no winning axis).

laguna-best.notes: Poolside Laguna XS 2.1 (MoE 33B / 3B active, agentic coding, OpenMDW-1.1, rel. 2026-07-02). Official sampling temp 1.0 / top_k 20 / top_p 1.0 (HF card poolside/Laguna-XS-2.1). CRITICAL: default context 262144 (256K) - num_ctx FORCED to 8192 (crash-guard like deepseek-r1 + apples-to-apples with fleet). Q4_K_M ~20 GB: route to 32 GB card, verify `ollama ps`=100% GPU (no CPU-spill, which taints quality). Thinking controllable (enable_thinking); code=false per fleet convention (single-shot codegen) - NOTE Poolside recommends thinking-ON for MULTI-STEP agentic, so the think=false code score is a floor, not its agentic strength. VERIFY baked params via `ollama show --parameters laguna-xs-2.1` after pull.

gemma12b-best.notes: Gemma 4 12B dense (Google, rel. 2026-06, ~7.6 GB). Gemma 4 official family sampling temp 1.0 / top_k 64 / top_p 0.95 (same official as e4b - NOT copied guesswork, it is the family card value). Unlike E4B, the 12B is NOT the thinking-exception variant - think=false disables thinking normally. Purpose: size-thesis sibling to gemma-best (e4b) - dense 12B vs 8B/4.5B-eff on the same axes. VERIFY thinking behavior + baked params via `ollama show --parameters gemma4:12b` before the canonical run.

ornith9b-best.notes: DeepReinforce Ornith 1.0 9B DENSE (post-trained on Qwen 3.5), agentic coding, MIT, rel. 2026-06-25. Sampling temp 0.6 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 20 (HF general rec). CODE measured think=false: MEASURED that think=true TRUNCATES single-shot code (4/9 tasks TR! even at num_predict=10000 - verbose thinking eats the budget, same pattern as qwen36). DeepReinforce's think-ON benchmarks are AGENTIC (SWE-Bench via OpenHands, multi-turn, 256K) - does NOT transfer to single-shot function-gen. num_ctx FORCED to 8192 (default 262144). Runs on macOS (Qwen3.5 arch).

ornith35b-best.notes: DeepReinforce Ornith 1.0 35B MoE (post-trained on Qwen 3.5 - SAME base family as unsloth-q4xl-best/qwen36), agentic coding, MIT, rel. 2026-06-25, ~21 GB Q4. Sampling temp 0.6 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 20. CODE measured think=false: think=true TRUNCATES single-shot code (measured: 4/9 tasks TR! at num_predict=10000 - thinking too verbose, same as qwen36). DeepReinforce's think-ON SWE-Bench is AGENTIC/multi-turn - does NOT transfer to single-shot function-gen (this benchmark). Article angle: single-shot code think-off ~5-7/9 (n=3, matches Qwen3.5 base tier) - its self-scaffolding RL edge is agentic, not captured here (benchmark != reality). num_ctx FORCED to 8192 (default 262144).
